name: CEHK
title: 特首及政府
brief: CEHK is Hong Kong's Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu (李家超), head of the Hong Kong SAR government, with the Chief Executive's Office (行政長官辦公室), the Executive Council (行政會議) he chairs, and his annual Policy Address (施政報告).
news_queries_en: "Chief Executive's Office" OR "Executive Council" Hong Kong

name: HKIC
title: 港投公司
brief: HKIC is the Hong Kong Investment Corporation (香港投資管理有限公司, 港投公司), the Hong Kong government's wholly owned investment company, led by its chief executive Clara Chan (陳家齊), with its investments and portfolio companies.
news_queries: 香港投資管理有限公司

name: FSHK
title: 財政司司長
brief: FSHK is Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po (陳茂波, 財政司司長, 財爺), who leads the government's financial and economic policy and presents the annual Budget (財政預算案).

name: SJHK
title: 律政司司長
brief: SJHK is Hong Kong's Secretary for Justice Paul Lam Ting-kwok (林定國, 律政司司長, SJ), who heads the Department of Justice (律政司), controls criminal prosecutions and is the government's principal legal adviser.
news_queries_en: "Secretary for Justice" OR "Department of Justice" Hong Kong

name: 政治花絮
title: 政壇專欄
brief: 政治花絮 is Hong Kong's insider politics and political gossip: who is up or down in the government, the Legislative Council (LegCo) and the Election Committee, personnel moves and rumoured appointments, the Chief Executive race, and the manoeuvring, alliances and relationships among officials, parties, chambers and Beijing's offices in Hong Kong (中聯辦, 港澳辦).

name: Galbot
title: 銀河通用 Galbot
brief: Galbot (銀河通用 / 银河通用, Beijing Galbot, Galaxy General Robot) is a Beijing humanoid-robot company; in Hong Kong it runs robot-staffed Galbot Stores (紅磡, 灣仔海濱, 啟德) with the robot shopkeeper 小蓋.

name: 選委選舉
title: 選委會及特首選舉
brief: 選委選舉 are Hong Kong's 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections (選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉; polled 22 Nov 2026), which formed the Election Committee, and the Chief Executive election (行政長官選舉 / 特首選舉) of March 2027, in which that committee nominates and elects the next Chief Executive, with the race for it.

name: 宏福苑
title: 大埔宏福苑火災
brief: 宏福苑 is Wang Fuk Court, a housing estate in Tai Po (大埔), Hong Kong, and the five-alarm fire there on 26 Nov 2025 (宏福苑大火, the Wang Fuk Court fire or Tai Po fire, 大埔火災) with everything since: its victims and residents, the investigations, accountability and the estate's future.
news_queries: 宏福苑 獨立委員會
